rationale: The record examines Nordic welfare state professions (health, education, care, and social work) under New Public Management reforms and has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01: wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the record fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4 (off-topic sociology/working-life article on Nordic welfare professions in health, education, care, and social work, unrelated to water or sanitation).

evidence_quotes.quote: Welfare professions constitute one of the backbones in the development of the Nordic welfare states.
The term welfare professions is widely used, referring to public sector employees in the field of, for example, health, education, care, and social work.
